integrity: The Birkhoff condition is reduced to supporting-functionals on edges and vertices. A standalone exact \(\mathbb Q(\sqrt5)\) checker exhausts every resulting one-dimensional affine-envelope cell and verifies the explicit maximizer. No independent audit or independent validation has been performed.
scientific_limitations: The result is specific to the affine regular decagonal plane and does not classify all polygonal Radon planes. The proof is finite and exact but computer-assisted, and absolute bibliographic uniqueness cannot be certified.
title: Exact \(T_{\perp}\) constant of the affine-regular decagonal Banach plane
